title: The Product That Learns
altText: Official NIST AI RMF GOVERN 5 excerpt describing a governed feedback loop that incorporates adjudicated external feedback into AI-system design and implementation.
caption: NIST AI RMF GOVERN 5: external feedback is collected, adjudicated and incorporated into system design and implementation.
credit: Tabassi, E. (2023), Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework (AI RMF 1.0), NIST AI 100-1, p. 24. Republished courtesy of NIST.
claimBoundary: Supports a governed product-learning feedback loop; it does not show that Build 007 implements NIST, learns correctly or improves outcomes.
noEndorsement: Use only the exact document treatment under its recorded terms. Exclude logos, seals, people and third-party material; attribution does not imply that National Institute of Standards and Technology endorses RN or Build 007.
